slides.title: Introduction to Pandas
slides.content:
# Pandas 🐼

Data analysis and manipulation!

## Installation

```bash
pip install pandas
```

## Key Structures

```python
import pandas as pd

# Series (1D)
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4])

# DataFrame (2D)
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Name': ['Alice', 'Bob'],
    'Age': [25, 30]
})
```

> 💡 **Pandas is essential for data science!**

slides.title: Reading Data
slides.content:
# Data Import/Export 📂

```python
# Read CSV
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Read Excel
df = pd.read_excel('data.xlsx')

# Read JSON
df = pd.read_json('data.json')

# Save
df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
```

## Quick Exploration

```python
df.head()        # First 5 rows
df.tail()        # Last 5 rows
df.info()        # Column types
df.describe()    # Statistics
df.shape         # (rows, cols)
```

slides.title: Data Selection
slides.content:
# Selecting Data 🎯

```python
# Single column
df['Name']

# Multiple columns
df[['Name', 'Age']]

# Rows by index
df.iloc[0]       # First row
df.iloc[0:3]     # First 3 rows

# Rows by label
df.loc[0]

# Filtering
df[df['Age'] > 25]
df[df['Name'] == 'Alice']

# Multiple conditions
df[(df['Age'] > 20) & (df['Age'] < 30)]
```

slides.title: Data Manipulation
slides.content:
# Transforming Data 🔄

```python
# Add column
df['Salary'] = [50000, 60000]

# Apply function
df['Age_Plus_10'] = df['Age'].apply(lambda x: x + 10)

# Grouping
df.groupby('Category')['Sales'].sum()

# Sorting
df.sort_values('Age', ascending=False)

# Handle missing
df.dropna()              # Remove rows with NaN
df.fillna(0)             # Replace NaN
df['Age'].fillna(df['Age'].mean())
```
